verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests a demonstration of the prototype's present working state as an acceptance artifact.
The client adds normal operating conditions and concrete evaluation criteria covering mixing performance, stability, and overall operation.
The client requires a video demonstrating both stations, matcha mixing, variable-speed operation, and applicable dispensing behavior.
The client makes leak repair a demonstration precondition and specifies concrete operational acceptance behaviors for the video.
The client narrows the final acceptance artifact to one uninterrupted liquid test showing dual operation, dispensing, sustained leak-free behavior, and a dry underside.
The client explicitly waives further pre-shipment testing and demonstration so the functioning prototype can ship in its present condition.

After the prior waiver, the client establishes a new task-local live FaceTime acceptance demonstration covering both stations and whisking with water or matcha; the administrative deadline is correctly excluded.
